extraction.notes: No 2027 information was found on the official website. The posted 2026 event ran July 3–6. Camp China describes itself as a weekend summer heritage camp designed for the entire family, with youth breakout sessions, parent programming and family activities; it is excluded under the family-only retreat rule rather than listed as a standalone youth camp.

excluded.name: Camp China
excluded.reason: Family-only heritage camp/retreat for families with children from China. Youth grade groups are breakout tracks within the whole-family event, not separately offered youth camps.

excluded.name: Adult Adoptees
excluded.reason: Adult-only activity track for adoptees age 18 and older.

excluded.name: Parents
excluded.reason: Adult-only programming within the family heritage camp.

excluded.name: Counselor Application
excluded.reason: Volunteer counselor application and staffing role, not a youth camp or counselor-in-training program.
